name: Real Signal Demultiplexer
description: The real signal demultiplexer function code outputs boolean signals based on a real input value. The real value can be converted to boolean values in three modes (select, integer and BCD). An unlimited number of real signal demultiplexer blocks may be linked together in the select mode (demultiplex the real input into the required number of boolean outputs). Up to four blocks may be linked together in the integer and BCD modes for demultiplexing. The first block in the link list is the group master. The master accepts the input signal and drives the outputs for the group.
